$comment: p15-oracle-069: the 24 mutations of the chief, conversation, room, participant and agent families (gen_daemon_ops.py reads this file; run it after an edit). The mock agent of the daemon product: the case daemon runs no agent process and holds no credential. Its environment is driver_daemon.py's env -i base, CMUX_TUI_CHIEF_BRAINS is unset, so no Chief brain starts (chief_brains.rs not_configured), and the agent actors of these cases are the fixture terminal, addressed by its terminal id (agent.report source hook, agent.message.send and mark to that terminal). No params here carry a token, key or credential, and gen_daemon_ops.py refuses a tuning value that looks like one. Each error case reaches the handler and asserts its refusal with errorDetails (the reason or the scope and id), not only the error code. The success cases that need a Chief brain, a local conversation, a bound agent participant or the verified cmux app have a gap naming the task that closes it, so coverage excludes them.
